  test:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build

  publish-dry-run:
    name: Publish Dry‑Run
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - run: |
          if npm run publish:dry-run; then
            echo "Dry‑run succeeded"
          else
            echo "Dry‑run failed"
            exit 1
          fi

  audit:
    name: npm Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm audit --audit-level high
